procedure: The coordinator observed the separate recovery checkout clean at the prior commit, fetched the handoff branch, checked out FETCH_HEAD detached, separately observed the stated commit and clean status, ran the full public evidence driver, and observed the same commit and clean status again.
prepublish_byte_equality: The complete recovery transcript equals the separately captured prepublish transcript byte for byte.
qualification: The transcript itself does not embed the checkout ID; the coordinator observed it separately. Fetch, checkout, verification and retained originals are on the same machine and do not establish independent-machine custody, complete privacy or product behavior. The prepublication record accurately states its earlier time when recovery was still ongoing.
